title: Not useful for precipitation predictions

title: Completely Inaccurate
body: When I first purchased this app I was suitably impressed by its local accuracy. In recent times, however, it’s become totally undependable. More often than not, it’s completely wrong. It’s telling me my area is experiencing “moderate snow” but a look out my window shows blue skies and not a flake to be found. I’m sorry I purchased this app because I’ve now grown accustomed to ignoring its forecast, predictions and real time observations. Consider yourself forewarned. Don’t make the same mistake that I did.

title: Disappointing lack of utility
body: I downloaded the app after reading a glowing review in Cult of Mac, but I’m frankly perplexed by their excitement. I understand that it is designed to be “hyperlocal”, which is great if you have no intention of going anywhere else, but why not include the ability to check out the hyperlocal weather/forecast at other locations, so you can make appropriate travel plans? Besides which it is generally interesting to be able to see real time weather elsewhere, so I’m puzzled that this is not a basic feature. And then, as far as I can see, the only kind of forecast data you can get is temperature. Why not also include the ability to bring up graphs of predicted wind, precipitation, cloud cover etc? If those improvements could be made (and assuming the AI works (I have no reason to believe it wouldn’t) then this could become a go-to app, but right now sadly it is not.
